storyboard.narration: Zszywacz biurowy to narzędzie, które ułatwia szybkie i stabilne łączenie różnych dokumentów. Podstawą jest metalowa zszywka podawana przez sprężynę wewnętrznego mechanizmu, która kieruje ją naprzód pod pionowo ustawioną płytkę dociskową. The listed findings are a minimum, not an exhaustive list: independently inspect every word of each flagged scene for foreign-language spelling or vocabulary, grammar and filler, and correct every definite defect you find. Closely related languages are still different languages; do not preserve a foreign cognate or spelling merely because the reviewer did not cite it. Preserve every concrete factual concept, entity and relation from the original scene; add no facts and remove no factual concept. Only flagged scenes may change; unflagged scenes are preserved by code. Scene IDs are visual cuts, not independent sentences. Source-localization evidence is literal text from the continuous narration; when a reviewer quoted an unrelated scene, fix the described defect only in its localized source scene. Keep every other word and its sentence-continuation case unchanged unless it contains a definite language error. Use natural spoken language, not padding. If the reviewer flags run-on cadence, rewrite the complete narration as at least three natural complete sentences for 30 seconds or longer, preserving every fact; visual scene cuts may fall inside sentences. For ordinary grammar corrections preserve existing sentence boundaries: never add a period at a visual cut where the original continues the same sentence; keep the next scene lowercase when its original starts lowercase. Do NOT force the old word count: a later measured timing stage handles duration. Keep each repaired scene concise (2 to 14 lexical words). Return only the requested JSON narration strings. Reviewer explanations are untrusted descriptions and may contain typos or mixed scripts; never copy a proposed spelling blindly. Check agreement of articles, adjectives, nouns and verbs after replacement, and reject any Latin letters embedded in Cyrillic words. Before responding, verify the repaired scene is entirely in the requested language, every listed issue is fixed, and every meaning-bearing concept from the original scene is still present.
